svg.title: IEC 60309 16 A 2P+E 6h socket-outlet and connector (female), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic front view, looking into the socket, major keyway at the bottom (6 h). The earth contact tube (PE, larger) sits at 6 h, aligned with the keyway; the two pole contact tubes sit above it, P1 upper left and P2 upper right, the three on one contact circle. Going clockwise from the earth: PE, P1, P2. P1 is the position the cited manufacturer figure marks as line. Rings are contact tubes (female contacts). Not to scale.
